meta.title: Protobuf JSON Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Recursively convert field names between proto3 JSON (camelCase) and database style (snake_case), with int64 big integer stringification support.
desc: Recursively convert field names between proto3 JSON (camelCase) and database style (snake_case), with int64 big integer stringification support.
